description: This file defines the DiagnosisService interface in the OpenMRS project, providing API method signatures for managing diagnoses, including CRUD operations and retrieval based on various filters.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a diagnosis object, requires EDIT_DIAGNOSES privilege.

methods.name: voidDiagnosis
methods.description: Voids an existing diagnosis, requiring EDIT_DIAGNOSES privilege.

methods.name: getDiagnosisByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a diagnosis by its UUID, requiring GET_DIAGNOSES privilege.

methods.name: getDiagnoses
methods.description: Fetches diagnoses for a patient since a specified date, requiring GET_DIAGNOSES privilege.

methods.name: getDiagnosesByEncounter
methods.description: Retrieves diagnoses associated with an encounter, with options for primary-only and confirmed-only, requires GET_DIAGNOSES privilege.

methods.name: getDiagnosesByVisit
methods.description: Retrieves diagnoses associated with a visit, with options for primary-only and confirmed-only, requires GET_DIAGNOSES privilege.

methods.name: getPrimaryDiagnoses
methods.description: Deprecated method for retrieving primary diagnoses for an encounter.

methods.name: getUniqueDiagnoses
methods.description: Retrieves unique diagnoses since a date for a patient.

methods.name: getDiagnosis
methods.description: Gets a diagnosis by its ID.

methods.name: unvoidDiagnosis
methods.description: Reverses voiding of a diagnosis, requiring EDIT_DIAGNOSES privilege.

methods.name: purgeDiagnosis
methods.description: Permanently deletes a diagnosis, requiring DELETE_DIAGNOSES privilege.

methods.name: getAllDiagnosisAttributeTypes
methods.description: Fetches all diagnosis attribute types, including retired ones.

methods.name: getDiagnosisAttributeTypeById
methods.description: Fetches a diagnosis attribute type by its ID.

methods.name: getDiagnosisAttributeTypeByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a diagnosis attribute type by its UUID.

methods.name: saveDiagnosisAttributeType
methods.description: Creates or updates a diagnosis attribute type.

methods.name: retireDiagnosisAttributeType
methods.description: Retires a diagnosis attribute type with a reason.

methods.name: unretireDiagnosisAttributeType
methods.description: Unretires a previously retired diagnosis attribute type.

methods.name: purgeDiagnosisAttributeType
methods.description: Permanently deletes a diagnosis attribute type.

methods.name: getDiagnosisAttributeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a diagnosis attribute by UUID.
